title: Harnessing the Spatial-Temporal Attention of Diffusion Models for High-Fidelity Text-to-Image Synthesis
property: object position and spatial relations from a trained text-only layout predictor; prompt match through CLIP
reads: Layout predictor reads only the caption through RoBERTa-base and outputs a 5-component Gaussian mixture over each object's centre; the weight loss reads the decoded final image and 224x224 object crops with CLIP ViT-B/32
trained_on: Layout predictor fine-tuned 100 epochs at batch 64 on MS-COCO captions with object centres (absolute NLL) and GPT-3 synthetic relation sentences over the 80 COCO categories (relative margin loss); training-set sizes not printed
gradient_enters: No latent update is printed: a CLIP loss on the final image optimises per-object, per-step attention blend weights lambda_it (Adam, lr 0.05, gamma 5, projected to [-1, 2]) over 50 PLMS steps; the layout loss is trained offline and applies at no diffusion step
unseen: no: no noun or category is held out from the layout predictor; the uncommon test recombines the COCO categories, and object recall counts only COCO categories
headline: On GPT-synthetic with SD1.4, object recall (% of mentioned COCO objects found by DETR, higher better) is 47.2 against 45.9 for Paint-with-Words; spatial relation precision (% correct, higher better) is 66.7 against 59.3 for Structure Diffusion
copy_or_avoid: Copy assigning each subject a region before steering attention into it; avoid decoded-image CLIP as the layout signal and do not cite this for transfer to unseen concepts (inferred)
why_added: trains a caption-only layout predictor, then tunes attention blend weights with a CLIP loss; named by SynGen, p. 10

disagreements.claim: The method optimises latents with the layout predictor
disagreements.paper_says: The optimised variables are the attention combination weights lambda_it under a CLIP loss; the layout predictor only supplies object regions, and no latent update is printed
